title: FlowDiffOutput
description: Output of `gentry flow diff --json`: the objects of the draft of the flow of a project that differ from the active flow: of its flow directory and of the shared subagents, which the draft of every project holds; and the file of changes with them in full.

applied.description: The commit that applied the active flow the draft is compared with; absent if the project has no flow, and then every object of the draft is added.

changes.description: Changed objects of the flow: the common rules first, then scenarios, stages, parts and subagents of the project, each kind by identifier. Empty if only the shared subagents have changes.

object.description: Kind of the object: common for the common rules of the flow, scenario, stage, part or agent for a subagent of the project.

id.description: Identifier of the object; absent for the common rules.

shared.description: The changes of the shared subagents; absent if they have none.

applied.description: The commit that last applied the shared subagents; absent if they have never been applied.

id.description: Identifier of the subagent, the name of its files.

projects.description: Projects whose flows name the subagent as the executor of a stage and do not replace it with a subagent of their own, sorted: the project of the command by its draft, the others by their active flows. May be empty.

report.description: Absolute path of the file of changes: schemas of the scenarios and the changed objects in full, in markdown. Gentry writes it anew at each call.

sync.description: What the synchronization before the command did; present only when there is something to tell.
